messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] synth-check 'synth-eu-heartbeat-02' (eu-west-1) triggered: 95% timeouts over 5m (threshold 10%). Page to SRE-Oncall sent. probe_id=eu-02-7f3a link=https://synth.home/s/eu-02

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Incident PD-4832 created for service=redwood-synth-checks -> escalated to SRE-Oncall. Details: high failure rate on eu synths.

maya: ack PD-4832, i'm on it :hand:

pagerduty-bot: maya acknowledged PD-4832

owen: also seeing a cluster of similar failures in us-west-2 but far fewer. looks correlated with synthetic fanout batch bursts.

maya: quick heads-up — last config change was a routing tweak for synth fanout to reduce load (rolled 12:10 UTC). checking metrics now. p95 latency for /v1/generate in eu jumped from 120ms -> 850ms.

jules: I didn't touch EU routing. infra autoscaler shows pool-eu-1 queue depth spike and GPU utilization at 99%. could be contention on the inference pool.

maya: runbook step1: reduce synthetic fanout & pause scheduled checks for EU. command in console -> "Pause Synthetic Job: synth-eu-heartbeat-*"

sam: i can mute PD alerts short-term while we mitigate. doing a 15m suppression now to avoid alert storms.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: PD-4832 suppressed for 15 minutes by sam.

maya: checking runtime logs from pool-eu-1, seeing repeated KV cache misses and model reload thrash. snippet:

```
2026-03-14T12:16:22Z pool-eu-1 worker-7 WARN cache_miss key=prefix-xyz
2026-03-14T12:16:22Z pool-eu-1 worker-7 INFO reload model=model-a quant=8bit
2026-03-14T12:16:23Z pool-eu-1 worker-7 ERROR oom allocating 2147483648 bytes
```

maya: that explains the spikes. looks like the recent cache key change caused continuous cold starts.

jules: ok, two simultaneous actions — 1) throttle synth fanout, 2) scale pool-eu-1 by +2 nodes. I'm on scaling.

owen: i'm validating customer impact — hitting logs for production front doors. early estimate: ~0.25% of total requests saw increased latency/errors from 12:10-12:25 UTC. Not a global outage.

lina: CS update: acme-corp messages support about slow responses for embeddings and generation, a few timeouts on sessions. they're monitoring but not yet elevated.

maya: executing rollback of the recent routing change for synths to previous stable config to stop thrash. command: `infra rollback-route --service synth-fanout --region eu-west-1 --to-tag stable-2026-03-14-11`

incident-bot: Rollback job started: job_id=rb-73a4. Notifying deployments.

jules: pool-eu-1 scaled +2 nodes, queue depth dropping. GPUs back to ~70% utilization.

owen: after rollback and scale, p95 down to ~140ms and synth failures falling to baseline. monitoring charts look healthy.

pagerduty-bot: PD-4832 updated: status=acknowledged, assigned_to=maya.

sam: re-enabling normal PD routing. suppression ended.

pagerduty-bot: PD-4832 suppression ended.

maya: can we confirm there are no additional model reloads? logs show reload count stabilized.

jules: verified — reloads stopped at ~12:20 UTC. KV hit-rate back to normal after rollback.

lina: CS: acme-corp confirmed improvement, will keep support ticket open for 2 hours.

maya: i'm going to resolve the immediate page in PD and create an incident for follow-up/root cause. follow-up owners: owen (postmortem), jules (runtime change review).

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: PD-4832 resolved by maya at 12:29 UTC.

maya: closing thread for live mitigation. please add any notes to the incident doc: https://incidents.redwood/pd/PD-4832.

owen: i'll own the postmortem, will include timeline, root cause (cache key change -> reload thrash), mitigations (circuit-breaker for model reloads, stricter canary gating for routing changes), and action items.

jules: i'll follow up with a patch to add a debounce on routing key rotations and increase guardrails on autoscaler thresholds.

maya: handoff: i'm offcall in 30m. handing to owen for the follow-up 08:00-16:00 shift. :white_check_mark:

owen: thanks — i'll pick this up. good catch everyone. :thumbsup:

maya reacted with :rocket:
